summary: Iteration-3 deployment-readiness validation: verified toast import fix (VerifyBanner resend button no longer throws JS runtime error) and DB-level query optimizations (GET /api/tips limit+cap100, /api/tips/mine limit100 sorted desc, /api/credits/transactions limit50 sorted desc). Added 8 new pytest cases (classes TestListingLimitsAndSort, TestMyTips, TestCreditTransactions). All 47 backend tests pass. Frontend E2E confirms signup + verify banner + resend flow work end-to-end with 2 sonner toasts and zero ReferenceError.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still ~1054 lines (past 700-line threshold). Recommend splitting into routers (auth/tips/credits/notifications/admin) — carried over from iteration-2 and now more warranted after adding indexes and query-optimization branches.

list_tips: after DB-side sort+limit, the code STILL re-sorts the returned list in Python (lines 568-573). This double-sort is redundant since MongoDB already returned sorted results. It's a minor perf/DRY smell — safe to remove the in-memory sort step now that the query is authoritative.

list_tips uses `find(q, {"_id": 0}).sort(...).limit(limit).to_list(limit)` which is correct, but note that for sort=top the compound sort ((avg_rating,-1),(ratings_count,-1)) is not backed by an index — startup adds only status/user_id/created_at indexes. Consider adding `db.tips.create_index([('avg_rating', -1), ('ratings_count', -1)])` and `db.tips.create_index('ai_rating', -1)` for hot sort paths at production scale.

GET /api/tips has no server-side pagination cursor (only a hard cap of 100). If the corpus grows beyond a few hundred pending tips, users cannot page beyond the first 100 newest. Consider adding `?before=<created_at>` or `?skip` for pagination.
credit_transactions has NO parameterized limit — hard-coded 50. Fine for now, but same lack-of-pagination caveat as list_tips.

Frontend: resend-verification button still lacks a rate-limit UX guard beyond `disabled={sending}`. If the request completes quickly, users can spam the button and create many verify tokens; consider a 30s cooldown timer or backend rate-limiting.

Frontend: two toasts stack on top of each other after signup->resend (signup success toast + dev verify link toast). Consider dismissing the signup toast when the resend toast fires, or lowering duration.

rca of the issue: No new bugs found. (4) credit_txns returns user's transactions sorted newest-first with limit(50) — 2 new tests pass.
